input: Find family-owned German machine-tool manufacturers (Mittelstand) with 100-500 employees

companies.name: HEDELIUS Maschinenfabrik GmbH
companies.employees: About 250 (as_of: undated; VDWF member profile accessed 2026-11-10). The profile lists the size band as 101–250 and also says 'more than 247' staff. Source: https://www.vdwf.de/netzwerk/mitglieder/hedelius-maschinenfabrik-gmbh.html

criteria_evidence.evidence: The company's own site calls HEDELIUS 'an independent family-run business' whose values have shaped it 'for three generations'. The VDWF profile describes it as a 'Familienunternehmen'. I found no PE or strategic owner.
Since 1967 it has developed and built vertical CNC travelling-column machining centres (3-, 4- and 5-axis) in Meppen, Germany.
About 250 employees (size band 101–250). The profile is undated.

companies.traction: More than 3,000 HEDELIUS machining centres installed (company site, accessed 2026-11-10). In Feb 2023 it started building a new 10,000 m² TILTENTA production hall on a 25,000 m² site, due for completion in spring 2024, to 'significantly increase our delivery capacities'. Sources: https://www.hedelius.de/en/company ; https://www.hedelius.de/en/news/hedelius-further-expands-site-in-meppen
companies.rank_reason: Best fit. The company's own site confirms it is family-run in its third generation. It is a pure machine-tool builder (CNC machining centres) with about 250 staff, in the middle of the range. It is investing in capacity and shows no sign of PE involvement.

companies.name: ELHA-MASCHINENBAU Liemke KG
companies.employees: 240 across two sites in Hövelhof (as_of: undated Wirtschaftsforum interview; page footer © 2026). Source: https://www.wirtschaftsforum.de/interviews/elha-maschinenbau-liemke-kg/den-ideen-gestalt-geben

criteria_evidence.evidence: Cousins Christof and Hans-Georg Liemke run the company, whose founder was their grandfather. The 85-year-old senior chief still works there daily, and Christof Liemke says he wants to carry on 'die Tradition des Familienunternehmens'.
It builds machining centres, special machines and production modules. It started with machines for local wood and metal firms and moved into drilling machines after WWII.

companies.traction: Annual revenue of €40–50M. Named customers include Daimler, Danfoss, Deutsche Bahn, MAN, Miele, Nissan, thyssenkrupp, Bosch and Volkswagen (as_of: undated interview). Source: https://www.wirtschaftsforum.de/interviews/elha-maschinenbau-liemke-kg/den-ideen-gestalt-geben
companies.rank_reason: Strong fit. It is owner-run by the third generation of the founding family, has 240 staff and blue-chip customers. It ranks below Hedelius because the only source is an undated interview, and much of its business is special and custom machines rather than standard ones.

companies.name: F. Zimmermann GmbH
companies.hq: Neuhausen auf den Fildern (Stuttgart region), Baden-Württemberg, Germany
companies.employees: 190 worldwide (as_of: careers page accessed 2026-11-10). Source: https://www.f-zimmermann.com/karriere/
companies.ownership: family-owned (Gänzle family; Rudolf Gänzle bought all shares in 1994, not the founding family)

criteria_evidence.evidence: The site says 'As a family-run company, we focus on people.' Rudolf Gänzle bought all shares in 1994. Frieder Gänzle (CEO) and Eva Gänzle (Head of Commercial) lead the company. The careers page calls it 'familiengeführt'.
Builds high-tech gantry (portal) milling machines for aerospace, defence, automotive and general industry. Headquarters is in Neuhausen a.d.F.

companies.headcount_growth: 170 employees (as_of 2008-07-17, https://www.region-stuttgart.de/unternehmensportraet/hidden-champion-die-f-zimmermann-gmbh-aus-denkendorf-baut-innovative-portalfraesmaschinen-und-feiert-in-diesem-jahr-ihr-75-jaehriges-bestehen/). About 140 to be based at the new Neuhausen HQ (as_of 2013-02-07, https://www.produktion.de/wirtschaft/f-zimmermann-gmbh-mehr-platz-nach-umzug/1641990). 190 worldwide (as_of 2026-11-10, https://www.f-zimmermann.com/karriere/). That is roughly +12% from 2008 to 2026. The 2013 figure covers the HQ only.
companies.traction: Named customers include Daimler, BMW, Volkswagen, Porsche, Opel, Ford, Airbus and Boeing. About 45% of orders came from automotive and 45% from aerospace, and 60–70% of output was exported (as_of 2008-07-17). Source: https://www.region-stuttgart.de/unternehmensportraet/hidden-champion-die-f-zimmermann-gmbh-aus-denkendorf-baut-innovative-portalfraesmaschinen-und-feiert-in-diesem-jahr-ihr-75-jaehriges-bestehen/
companies.rank_reason: Good fit. It is a family-run machine-tool specialist with a current, company-stated headcount of 190. It ranks third because the family has owned it only since 1994 (Gänzle buyout), not as founders. It is also the smallest of the three, and its customer evidence is old (2008).

output.search_notes:
Today is 2026-11-10. Missing fields: last_round is null for all three, because no outside funding was found and these are family-owned firms. headcount_growth is null for HEDELIUS and ELHA. HEDELIUS: search snippets mention 235 (June 2023 press release) and 247 (StepStone ad), but I couldn't read the PDF, so the figures aren't used. ELHA: a 2020 its-owl deck reportedly said 200 (Aug 2019) and 240, but the page returned 404. The HEDELIUS VDWF profile and the ELHA interview are undated.

Excluded (fails criteria): KERN Microtechnik, acquired by AMETEK in Feb 2025 according to search results. J.G. Weisser Söhne, taken over in a management buy-out by four managers after its 2024 insolvency, so no longer family-owned (press reports seen only in search). SPINNER Werkzeugmaschinenfabrik is owner-family run but has about 600 staff across the group (https://www.spinner.eu.com/über-spinner), above 500. Nagel Technologies has 400 in Nürtingen but more than 1,800 across the group. Carl Benzinger GmbH: in Jan 2024 the Jehle family sold a majority to Syngroh Capital, the Grohe family's investment firm, so the founding family no longer owns it. A. Monforts Werkzeugmaschinen was in insolvency and looking for an investor.

Not verified, so not listed: Röders GmbH (Soltau, HSC milling machines; 6th-generation pewter line). The company's pages gave no headcount or ownership, and the '395 employees in Soltau' figure appeared only in a search snippet. Supfina Grieshaber (Wolfach, more than 200 employees per https://www.wirtschaftsforum.de/supfina-grieshaber-gmbh-co-kg): I couldn't confirm the owners. Alzmetall (Altenmarkt; 251–500 per a directory snippet): ownership not confirmed. Haas Schleifmaschinen (Trossingen; about 110 employees, older figure): ownership not confirmed. KADIA and Thielenhaus: no reliable headcount or ownership.

Next steps: check the shareholders of Röders, Supfina, Alzmetall and Haas in the Handelsregister or Bundesanzeiger, and check VDW member and EMO exhibitor lists for more names.
